HOW TO PLAY

How to play

  1. Each round, one person secretly ranks five topics from favorite (1) to least favorite (5). No ties.
  2. Everyone else discusses and submits one shared guess of that order.
  3. Each exact position match earns the team one point. Each miss earns the game one point.
  4. After everyone has ranked once, compare the scores. If the team leads, everyone wins. If the game leads, everyone loses. A tie goes to another round.

Categories

Select one or more categories. Choose one category per round to rotate through them, or mix categories to draw across your selection. Unseen cards are used before repeats. Custom cards can be used on their own or with built-in categories.

Turn timer

Choose no timer, 60, 90, or 120 seconds per turn. Ranking and guessing each get a fresh countdown. Pause it or add 30 seconds at any time. The timer pauses when you switch away. Time running out is a reminder, not a penalty: lock in your answer or add time.

Connection score

The ranker predicts how many cards the team will match. The team predicts its own match rate. Connection score = 40 × match rate + 60 × confidence accuracy.

Confidence accuracy is 1 minus the average absolute difference between each prediction and the actual match rate (all expressed from 0 to 1). The connection score does not affect who wins. The final score averages all rounds.

This is a shared-device game. Look away when passing the device. Secret rankings are stored in this browser.
